Coaching track · Lean Six Sigma

Process improvement and optimisation coaching

Most organisations know their processes are slow. Few can say exactly where the time goes, or fix it in a way that lasts. Learn to map, measure and improve processes the way a Lean Six Sigma Black Belt does, and apply it to real work.

Book a free 30-minute call Book a 1:1 session · AED 400

Who it's for

  • Business analysts adding process improvement to their toolkit
  • Operations, quality and shared-services professionals moving into process excellence roles
  • People preparing for Lean Six Sigma projects or certification who want real-world practice
  • Teams that need to fix a specific process, not just learn the theory

What we work on

Mapping the as-is honestly

Process maps and BPMN that show how work actually flows, including the workarounds nobody writes down.

Finding the waste

Spotting delays, rework, handoffs and bottlenecks, and sizing which ones are worth fixing.

Measuring what matters

Baselines, cycle times and simple metrics that prove an improvement worked.

Designing the to-be

Redesigning processes with the people who run them, so the new way is actually adopted.

Automation and technology

When to automate, when to simplify first, and how to write requirements for process tools.

Making change stick

Controls, ownership and communication that stop processes drifting back.

Why learn this with Tosin

Tosin is a Lean Six Sigma Black Belt and Green Belt who has led process improvement across HR, workflow automation and operations in telecoms, real estate and the public sector.

Every session is built around your real situation: the role you're going for, the project you're on, or the process you need to fix. You leave each one with written action points.

Questions about process improvement & optimisation coaching

Is this Lean Six Sigma certification training?

It's practical coaching in process improvement methods, taught by a certified Black Belt. It's ideal preparation for Lean Six Sigma projects and complements formal certification courses.

Can you help improve a specific process in our organisation?

Yes. For organisations, work can be scoped around a real process, improving it while building your team's skills. Book a free consultation to discuss it.

Do I need a business analysis background?

No. Process improvement coaching suits operations, quality and shared-services professionals as well as BAs.

No obligation. You'll leave with a clear picture of your next step in process improvement & optimisation.
